北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有雾，体感 7℃ 较凉。出行注意安全，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy and feels chilly at 7℃. Please drive safely and dress warmly!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波有雾，体感 20℃ 湿润。湿度较高，记得多喝水哦！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is foggy and feels humid at 20℃. With high humidity, remember to drink more water!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，湿度大。出行注意交通安全，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy with high humidity. Drive safely and keep a good mood!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 24℃ 宜人。外出散步，感受好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and a pleasant 24℃. Enjoy a walk outside!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 26℃ 微暖。风力 3级，出门很舒服哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels warm at 26℃. With a moderate breeze, it's lovely outside!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，体感 18℃。驾车请减速慢行，注意安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and feels 18℃. Please drive slowly and safely!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有小雨，体感 9℃ 较凉。出门记得带伞，多穿一点哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has light rain and feels cool at 9℃. Remember your umbrella and dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃。注意保暖，别让湿气钻了空子哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels 11℃. Keep warm and stay dry!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 11℃ 湿凉。出行注意安全，保持好心情！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and feels damp at 11℃. Drive safely and keep a good mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 7℃ 略凉。多晒太阳，记得添衣保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but feels a bit cool at 7℃. Enjoy the sun, but remember to layer up!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 13℃。山城景色朦胧，记得注意出行安全！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels 13℃. Enjoy the misty views, but drive safely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾，体感 -5℃ 寒冷。务必全副武装，注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is hazy and feels a bitter -5℃. Bundle up completely and stay warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 7℃ 凉爽。出门加件外套，小心着凉哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels cool at 7℃. Wear a jacket when you go out to avoid catching a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 10℃。风力 4级 较大，注意防风保暖哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels 10℃. The wind is strong, so protect yourself from it and stay warm!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，气温 23℃ 舒适。适合漫步海边，享受惬意时光！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and a comfortable 23℃. Perfect for a leisurely stroll by the sea!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有小雨，体感 11℃。出门带伞，小心路滑注意安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain and feels 11℃. Bring an umbrella, and watch out for slippery roads!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 11℃ 略凉。风力 3级，出门别忘了加件衣裳！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and feels a bit cool at 11℃. With a moderate breeze, don't forget to add a layer!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，气温 23℃ 宜人。风力 3级，出门感受清新空气吧！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast and a pleasant 23℃. With a moderate breeze, enjoy the fresh air!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感舒适。湿度较高，注意通风哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels comfortable. High humidity, remember to ventilate!
